critical_code_review_comments: The error 'Cannot access at before initialization' is a temporal dead zone (TDZ) error in JavaScript

This typically occurs when: (1) A variable is accessed before its declaration in the same scope, (2) Circular dependencies cause import order issues, (3) A const/let variable is used before initialization
The error is in the production bundle - need to check recent changes to imports or module structure
